Sandbox_ProjectGolf_MoodBoost_tooltip: Each swing lowers boredom and unhappiness a little; sinking a putt lowers them more. Losing a ball in water is a little upsetting.
Sandbox_ProjectGolf_AimingXP_tooltip: A small amount of Aiming XP for each shot, and a bit more for sinking it.
Sandbox_ProjectGolf_AimingSkill_tooltip: Higher Aiming makes shots more accurate and overswings less likely to mishit. Low Aiming shows only part of the preview line and a rough power-to-hole marker; the full line comes at level 6 and an exact marker at level 7.
